findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is 1e247094a20a0058810bfa30806f84b628bcba0d47240bcd033f80d3bdf397c3; all 5 declared sources passed current HTTPS access review.
Five controlled official source objects total 9,528,232 bytes and retain individual SHA-256 identities documented in the selection decision and article.
The current Comptroller manuals supply long-account, short-account, R-number, parcel-number, GIS-ID, and separate-record boundaries.
The current RRC query guide supplies API wellbore, district-plus-lease or gas-well, and unique P-5 operator-number roles.
The RRC district-and-operator index and PDQ FAQ supply the co-displayed-field and bounded API-to-lease lookup contexts without establishing private-property identity.

sources_inspected.label: Texas RRC About Oil and Gas Data Queries (accessed 2026-08-31)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official RRC query guide distinguishes an API wellbore number, district plus oil lease number or gas-well ID for a completion, and the unique P-5 operator number.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article treats those labels as regulatory identifiers and does not use them to establish a private-property connection, title, ownership, royalty entitlement, production, value, or transaction result.

sources_inspected.label: Texas RRC Oil Leases and Gas Wells by District and Operator (accessed 2026-08-31)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official monthly index supplies the co-displayed operator, lease, field, county, and oil-or-gas labels.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article does not infer that co-display makes the fields interchangeable or that a similar name proves a join to an owner record.

sources_inspected.label: Texas RRC Production Data Query System FAQs (accessed 2026-08-31)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official RRC FAQ supplies the bounded API-to-lease-information lookup sequence and the monthly, revisable production-snapshot limitation.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article does not reproduce a PDQ query worksheet or claim that a regulatory identifier establishes final data or owner-specific facts.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Comptroller Electronic Appraisal Roll Submission Manual (accessed 2026-08-31)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current Comptroller manual distinguishes the appraisal district long or geographic account number, short account or R-number, and potentially different GIS parcel ID.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article does not use an appraisal identifier to decide account correctness, legal description, title, tax amount, private value, or an offer.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Comptroller Electronic Property Transaction Submission Manual (accessed 2026-08-31)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current Comptroller transaction manual describes the short account or R-number as locally assigned and requires a separate record when a transaction contains multiple accounts.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses that rule only to support separate identifier rows and does not interpret a sale, deed, appraisal, or owner-specific transaction.
